oneLine: The fixed 3-chars-per-token divisor is a credible source of overcount, and the inferred historical ratios are substantial; however, the six unsubmitted candidates support only empirical point projections, not proof that all six compactions were unnecessary.

exercisedProductionSeam.seam: createContextCompactionPrepareTurn({ strategy }) — the compaction prepare-turn function the runtime installs
exercisedProductionSeam.notAHelperTest: Every asserted token number is the production resolver's OWN published value, captured through the real diagnostics sink channel (onCompactionDiagnostics). The suite does not re-implement the estimator, the trigger math, the projection, or the budget guard.
productionModulesExercised: sdk/packages/shared/src/llms/tokens.ts — estimateRequestInputTokens (the ONE estimator used by both gates)
sdk/packages/core/src/extensions/context/compaction.ts — createContextCompactionPrepareTurn, the trigger, the underestimate factor, the decision record

suite.command: cd sdk/packages/core && bun x vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/extensions/context/compaction.estimator-parity01.test.ts
suite.credentials: SYNTHETIC_ONLY — the suite asserts that no credential or message body reaches the published decision record

findings.title: The synthetic decision candidate estimate equals the dispatched request's estimate
findings.evidence: For the same synthetic provider-visible input, the production resolver's published apiMessageTokens + requestOverheadTokens equals estimateRequestInputTokens byte for byte.
findings.consequence: The synthetic seam establishes estimator reproducibility. It does not establish byte-identical identity between historical decisions and completions.

findings.title: The inferred historical ratio is substantial against the session's own calibration
findings.evidence: Over 107 inferred non-compacting pairs the session's provider-reported usage implies 4.129 chars/token on the message payload (3.473 on the full wire bytes). The estimator bills 3 chars/token. Estimated/reported median = 1.497827.
findings.consequence: Estimator overcount is credible, but historical pairing remains inferred and cannot prove same-request identity.

findings.title: The provider usage contract is complete-prompt, not uncached-only
findings.evidence: @ai-sdk/openai-compatible convertOpenAICompatibleChatUsage sets inputTokens.total = prompt_tokens and inputTokens.cacheRead = prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (a SUBSET). ClineMM reads usage.inputTokens.total (ai-sdk.ts:1270-1271). The session's own consistency confirms it: providerRequestBytes / inputTokens has CV 0.0732, while (inputTokens + cacheReadTokens) / providerRequestBytes has CV 0.2214.
findings.consequence: inputTokens and cacheReadTokens are NOT disjoint. Adding them double-counts the cached portion. This ACT did NOT add them.

findings.title: The trigger arithmetic reconciles exactly for all 114 decisions
findings.evidence: rawMaxInputTokens / underestimateFactor * COMPACTION_TRIGGER_RATIO reproduces the reported requestTriggerTokens (103680) for every decision, and requestInputTokens >= requestTriggerTokens reproduces the reported shouldCompact for all 114 (0 mismatches). compactionInitiated == shouldCompact for all 114.
findings.consequence: The trigger math is sound; the suspected issue is in the ESTIMATE, not the comparison.

findings.title: All six Round C compactions project below the trigger under the session calibration
findings.evidence: Each candidate needed a chars/token ratio of 2.860-3.046 to have stayed below the trigger; the session's observed ratio is 4.129. The candidates' empirical point projections are 71,830-76,488, all below the 103,680 trigger, while their production estimates were 104,542-110,953.
findings.consequence: The projection is consistent with unnecessary compaction, but it is not a conservative bound or direct measurement and therefore does not prove necessity for all six.

correlationControls.reason: The trace exports no per-request identifier spanning decision, dispatch and completion. decisionId is minted on the decision seam only; modelRequestId is minted AFTER the decision seam (agent-runtime.ts:2915) and is not in LATENCY_METADATA_ALLOWLIST.
correlationControls.pairingMethod: ORDER_PRESERVING — each decision pairs with the FIRST provider completion starting strictly after it. A positional zip is incorrect (114 decisions vs 113 completions; a compaction decision is followed by a compaction execution, not by the request it pre-empted).
negativeControlsApplied: A decision with no provider completion after it is EXCLUDED from the ratio population rather than paired against a missing denominator.
Compaction decisions are EXCLUDED from the inferred ratio population: their candidate was never submitted, so no provider usage exists for it.

The suite asserts that the synthetic candidate and dispatched projection are the same estimate, so a compaction that changed the synthetic request could not be silently compared as parity; this is not authoritative historical request identity.
A throwing sink and a disabled sink are both exercised: the disabled sink must produce NO decision capture, and the throwing sink must not change the compaction outcome in either direction.
No fabricated zero or synthetic provider usage is used anywhere in the ratio population; the historical relationship itself remains chronologically inferred.

synthetic: The 19-test production-seam suite uses synthetic messages, synthetic tools and synthetic credentials.
The fake provider's usage numbers are synthetic.
real: The 114 decision observations, the 113 provider completions, the 6 compaction executions and all token counts come from the uploaded Round C trace (SHA-256 631a506d0719314373bab801dfc70f646cca508318f87c59cdc5e3e2a1e517df).
The chars-per-token calibration is derived from that trace's own 107 measured pairs.
syntheticVersusReal.claimBoundary: No claim is made that the synthetic fake provider reproduces live Strata behaviour. The suite establishes the ACCOUNTING CONTRACT and the production seam's behaviour; the trace establishes the real session's numbers.

necessityProof.projectedActualInputMethod: EMPIRICAL_POINT_PROJECTION from the session's own observed chars/token rate applied to the candidate's measured apiMessagesJsonChars — NOT a conservative bound, authoritative tokenizer measurement, or direct measurement of the unsubmitted candidate
necessityProof.sameRequestContentAuthority: SYNTHETIC_PRODUCTION_SEAM only; historical request identity is INFERRED_CHRONOLOGICAL_PAIRING.
necessityProof.genuinelyOversizedStillCompacts: ASSERTED_AND_GREEN in the production-seam suite (800,000-char request over a 115,200-token limit compacts; the underestimate factor still engages and scales the trigger down; the unknown-model-limit path still fails closed with no decision published).
